faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I have to pay fees if I don’t sell my car?
faq.a1: No, there are no fees for you. Our service is completely free. By the way: With us you can also sell your defective car.
faq.q2: How do I sell my car after receiving the final sale price?
faq.a2: After you receive your final sale price, you will book a drop-off date at one of our stores near you. On site, the car details are confirmed by one of our employees. The purchase contract is then set up and the sale of your car is concluded with your signature. The car stays right in our branch. We will transfer your money to you and sign up your car for you for free.
faq.q3: How do I book my submission date?
faq.a3: After the online review, you will receive your final sale price by email. At the same time, we will send you a link so that you can easily book your delivery date on our website.
faq.a4: You will come to one of our more than 200 branches nationwide for your booked delivery date. An employee confirms your entries. We conclude a purchase contract with you and transfer the sale price to you. We will take care of the unsubscription and send you a unsubscribe confirmation.
faq.q5: How do you pay the selling price for my car?
faq.a5: We will transfer the sale price to your bank account immediately and absolutely securely after the sale. You will receive your money comfortably, reliably and safely. A cash payment is unfortunately not possible for security and organizational reasons.
faq.a6: If you have any further questions, you will find the answer in our FAQ section. What our more than 5 million satisfied customers think about us, you will find in our experience area.
faq.contactDesc: Call us or message us. We’re available 7 days a week.

meta.title: How It Works | Autoankauf Germany
meta.description: Discover how easy it is to buy or sell a car with us. Just 4 steps to success — fast, fair and hassle-free.

soFunktionierts.heroSubtitle: Whether you are a buyer or seller — our process is transparent, fast and stress-free. Success in just a few steps.
soFunktionierts.sellerStep1Desc: Fill out our smart online form. Enter the make, model, year, mileage and condition of your vehicle — quickly, securely and completely free.
soFunktionierts.sellerStep2Desc: Our experts analyse your vehicle using current market data and create a fair, non-binding offer. You receive the assessment by phone or email.
soFunktionierts.sellerStep3Desc: If you accept our offer, we arrange a convenient appointment together. Our professional team comes to you — nationwide, at no extra cost.
soFunktionierts.sellerStep3D3: At your home or our branches
soFunktionierts.sellerStep4Desc: At vehicle handover, we check everything on-site, handle all paperwork and pay you instantly — cash or instant bank transfer.
soFunktionierts.buyerStep1Desc: Browse our growing portfolio of inspected used cars. Filter by make, model, price and mileage.
soFunktionierts.buyerStep2Desc: Interested? Send us a request for your desired vehicle. Our expert team advises you personally and arranges a test drive.
soFunktionierts.buyerStep3Desc: Visit the vehicle in person or have it inspected by our TÜV-certified experts. Optionally reserve online.
soFunktionierts.buyerStep4Desc: Sign the contract, pay and drive away immediately. We handle registration and all formalities. Home delivery available on request.
soFunktionierts.timelineSubtitle: Completed in an average of 48 hours
soFunktionierts.tl2Desc: Our team evaluates your vehicle professionally
soFunktionierts.tl3Desc: Flexible, at your home or at our branch
soFunktionierts.tl4Desc: Instant payout — cash or bank transfer
soFunktionierts.whySubtitle: We are setting new standards in the German car market — through transparency, speed and real added value.
soFunktionierts.adv1Desc: No lengthy paperwork, no long waits. From enquiry to payout often only 2–3 days.
soFunktionierts.adv2Desc: Legally binding contracts, TÜV-certified vehicles and SSL-encrypted data protect you completely.
soFunktionierts.adv3Desc: Our valuations are based on current market data and over 10 years of experience. You always get a fair price.
soFunktionierts.adv4Desc: With locations in over 50 German cities and free pickup and delivery service, we are always near you.
soFunktionierts.adv5Desc: All vehicles go through a 150-point inspection. Only vehicles that meet our high standards enter our portfolio.
soFunktionierts.adv6Desc: Our service is and remains free for you. What we offer is exactly what you get — no surprises.
soFunktionierts.reviewsSubtitle: Real experiences from people who have already gone through our process
soFunktionierts.r1Text: I would not have thought the sale could be so straightforward. Filled out the form, got the offer, set the date — 3 days later the money was in my account.
soFunktionierts.r2Text: The offer was fair and transparent. No haggling, no pressure. Exactly how I picture professional car buying.
soFunktionierts.r3Text: As a buyer I was impressed by the transparency. All vehicle info, TÜV report and a test drive — all arranged effortlessly.
soFunktionierts.faqSubtitle: Still have open questions? Here you will find answers to the most common questions from our customers.
soFunktionierts.faqContactDesc: Our team is available for you 7 days a week — by phone, WhatsApp or email.
soFunktionierts.faq1Q: What documents do I need to sell my vehicle?
soFunktionierts.faq1A: You need: vehicle registration document (Part II), vehicle registration certificate (Part I), all available keys and if applicable the service booklet. We help you with all further formalities.
soFunktionierts.faq2Q: How quickly will I receive an offer for my vehicle?
soFunktionierts.faq2A: After receiving your request, you will receive a binding offer from us within 24 hours. In urgent cases we are even faster — just call us directly.
soFunktionierts.faq3Q: Do you also buy vehicles with accident damage or high mileage?
soFunktionierts.faq3A: Yes! We buy vehicles in any condition — with accident damage, engine damage, high mileage or technical problems. Every vehicle receives a fair, individual offer.
soFunktionierts.faq4Q: How and when do I receive my money after the sale?
soFunktionierts.faq4A: You receive your money directly at vehicle handover — either as cash payment or instant bank transfer. No waiting times, no tricks.
soFunktionierts.faq5Q: Is the service free for both buyers and sellers?
soFunktionierts.faq5A: Yes, our service is completely free for both sides. There are no hidden fees or commissions whatsoever.
soFunktionierts.faq6Q: Is there a return policy for buyers?
soFunktionierts.faq6A: Yes, buyers enjoy a 14-day return policy. Should the vehicle not meet your expectations, we take it back and refund the full purchase price.
soFunktionierts.faq7Q: In which cities are you represented?
soFunktionierts.faq7A: We are represented nationwide in over 50 cities with our own locations, including Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Cologne and Stuttgart. The pickup and delivery service covers all of Germany.

ueberUns.heroSubtitle: For over a decade we have been buying cars fairly, quickly and transparently. Personal service with real added value — nationwide.
ueberUns.storyCardText: What started as a small idea has become Germany's most trusted car buying platform.

ueberUns.storyP2: Unlike large anonymous platforms, we rely on personal contact and individual advice. You are not a number with us — you are our valued customer. Every vehicle receives a fair, market-based valuation by our experts.
ueberUns.storyP3: Our recipe for success: transparency, speed and genuine commitment to our customers. Over 5,000 successfully processed vehicles speak for us.
ueberUns.valSubtitle: Every decision we make is based on these core values — for an experience that convinces.

ueberUns.val2Desc: From enquiry to payout — everything runs quickly, smoothly and without hassle.
ueberUns.val3Desc: Legally binding processing, SSL-encrypted data and transparent processes protect you completely.
ueberUns.val4Desc: Your trust is our greatest asset. That is why we give our best on every purchase.
ueberUns.val5Desc: 10+ years of experience and current market data allow us to always make fair and precise offers.

blogPage.sellGuideText: Selling a car doesn't have to be complicated. With the right preparation and the right partner, you can sell your vehicle quickly, safely and at a fair market price — without any stress.
blogPage.buyGuideTitle: What to look out for when buying a used car
blogPage.buyGuideText: Buying a used car requires careful inspection and research. Our certified experts ensure every vehicle meets the highest quality standards before it enters our portfolio.
blogPage.faqSubtitle: Find answers to the most common questions from buyers and sellers. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us directly.
blogPage.faq1Q: How do I get the best price for my car?
blogPage.faq1A: The best price comes from thorough preparation: clean and polish your car, gather all service records, address minor issues, and get multiple valuations. With us, you'll receive a fair market-based offer within 24 hours — completely free and non-binding.
blogPage.faq2Q: What documents do I need to sell my car?
blogPage.faq2A: You need: the vehicle registration document (Part II / title), the registration certificate (Part I), all available keys, and ideally the service booklet. We handle all further formalities — deregistration, paperwork, and transfer — completely free of charge.
blogPage.faq3Q: Do you also buy accident or high-mileage vehicles?
blogPage.faq3A: Yes! We buy vehicles in any condition — accident-damaged, high mileage, mechanical issues or even total write-offs. Every vehicle receives an individual, fair valuation based on its actual market value.
blogPage.faq4Q: How quickly will I receive payment after the sale?
blogPage.faq4A: You receive payment immediately at vehicle handover — either as a bank transfer or cash. No waiting periods, no complications. We process everything on the spot.
blogPage.faq5Q: How is the value of my car determined?
blogPage.faq5A: Vehicle value is determined by multiple factors: make, model, year, mileage, condition, service history, accident history and current market demand. Our experts combine current market data with over 10 years of hands-on experience to give you a precise and fair valuation.
blogPage.faq6Q: Can I sell my car if there is still financing on it?
blogPage.faq6A: Yes. We can help you settle your existing financing directly as part of the sale process — we pay off the remaining balance to your bank and transfer any remaining amount to you. Simple and hassle-free.
blogPage.faq7Q: Is there a return policy when buying from you?
blogPage.faq7A: Yes, all vehicles purchased from us come with a 14-day return policy. If the vehicle does not meet your expectations after purchase, we will take it back and refund the full purchase price — no questions asked.
blogPage.faq8Q: Do I need an appointment for a vehicle inspection?
blogPage.faq8A: No appointment is needed for a preliminary valuation — just fill out our online form. For the actual handover, we'll schedule a convenient time that works for you, including weekends and even home visits across Germany.
